description: Where does each course or exam land at one receiving school? Each typed item uses GoldCheck's shared combined parent, retaining its full evidence and separate known/inferred results. Sources 1-4 select gathered published comparables, school-published CourseAtlas equivalencies, and each source's inferred paths through anchors. The effective selection is stated; unselected engines say not_requested. Omitted catalog arguments retain kind known; explicit sources without kind select from all four. Actual school/exam identities and ambiguity are retained. Failed or budget-limited reads are unread rather than no-rule findings. Inferred paths remain separate from confirmed coverage and checklist progress. Recognition remains the school's act. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

items.description: What was taken: each item a course (its school by unitid or name, with code or title) or an exam (exam_program with exam). At most 60 in one call.

code.description: The course code as printed, e.g. HIST 201

exam.description: For an exam: the exam as printed, by title or code

exam_program.description: For an exam: its program, e.g. AP

item_id.description: Optional: the caller's own id for this item, echoed back; the position is used when absent

school.description: Or: the course's school, by name

score.description: For an exam: its actual held score, a string or number. When omitted, published tiers can be shown but no held score is established.

title.description: Or: the course title, matched exactly

unitid.description: The course's school, by IPEDS UNITID

kind.description: known selects sources 1-2, inferred selects 3-4, both selects all four; intersects explicit sources. With neither argument supplied, the catalog's existing known default applies. Explicit sources without kind selects from all four.

limit.description: Optional page size per item's rules (default 10, at most 50)

sources.description: Optional information-source selection: all (default), or a nonempty array of distinct numbers: 1 gathered published CourseShelf comparables, 2 school-published CourseAtlas equivalencies, 3 inferred CourseShelf comparability through anchors, 4 inferred CourseAtlas equivalency through anchors. Any combination is allowed. An explicit kind intersects this selection; an empty intersection is invalid. Unselected engines report not_requested. Required identity/reference reads may still be needed. Send continuation arguments unchanged.

target_unitid.description: The receiving school, by IPEDS UNITID
